x, y, n = map(int, input().split())
best_num = 0
best_den = 1
min_diff = 1e18
for b in range(1, n + 1):
    a1 = b * x // y
    a2 = (b * x + y - 1) // y
    diff1 = abs((a1 / b) - (x / y))
    diff2 = abs((a2 / b) - (x / y))
    if diff1 < min_diff and abs(diff1 - min_diff) > 1e-15:
        min_diff = diff1
        best_num = a1
        best_den = b
    if diff2 < min_diff and abs(diff2 - min_diff) > 1e-15:
        min_diff = diff2
        best_num = a2
        best_den = b
print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
